chunks: O believers, if you listen to the infidels they will make you turn your backs, and you will be the losers.

key_terms.عَلَىٰ أَعْقَابِكُمْ: On your heels / heels of your feet (idiom for turning back)
key_terms.يَرُدُّوكُمْ: They will make you return / turn back

ai.seo_question: What happens to believers if they follow the disbelievers according to Surah Aal-Imran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as a warning against blind conformity to non-Muslims in matters of faith and law, which leads to 'regression on one's heels' (al-ruj' 'ala al-aqab), symbolizing a loss of spiritual momentum and status. It underscores the necessity of maintaining distinct Islamic identity and adherence to the Ahl al-Bayt's guidance to avoid the fate of those who abandon their covenant. The consequence is not merely failure, but a reversal of one's spiritual journey, rendering previous efforts void.
